413-1981-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-5468.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent loses 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

5671-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
5671-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating either a 0/1 green Plant creature token or a 2/2 black Zombie creature token depending on how many uniquely named lands you control
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

1339-3394-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3394-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

803-3899-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
803-3899-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

222-527-728-969.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3861-3967-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

494-1172.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Ribbons from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and all remaining available mana, causing each opponent to lose a significant amount of life.
494-1172.notes: The more life you have, the more life your opponents will lose. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Ribbons.

3240-3967-5632-6462.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token, Clue token and creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-4050-4581-7419-7536.description:
Cast a copy of Ancestral Recall by paying {U}.
Nantuko Shrine and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Nantuko Shrine trigger, creating at least one 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten, blinking Emeritus of Ideation, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding one mana.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5231-6094.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3967-4677-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

232-864-1235-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Eternal Witness.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Eternal Witness with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Eternal Witness tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

4943-7070--141.easyPrerequisites: You are able to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more.
4943-7070--141.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the affinity creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to its affinity ability.
Repeat.
4943-7070--141.notes: You want to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more using its affinity ability. For example, if you choose Ancestral Statue, you need to control two or more attacking creatures.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-5007-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1497-5220-5332-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

585-4508-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
585-4508-6847.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, giving Weftstalker Ardent the Pirate creature type until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Unnatural Selection, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

567-2577-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
567-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2105-3719-4050-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six creatures, excluding Combat Celebrant, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Combat Celebrant or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2105-3719-4050-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping six creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, adding {1}.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1789-4452-5256-5649.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-4452-5256-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4779-5365-5395.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
4779-5365-5395.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' third ability and Piper Wright's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Piper Wright trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability from step 1.
Repeat.

24-220-1640.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Brash Taunter instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-220-1640.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

1558-3529-4231-4890.notablePrerequisites:
Dack's Duplicate is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-4890.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1379-1558-3598.notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness.
Rapacious One cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1379-1558-3598.description:
Deal combat damage using Rapacious One.
Rapacious One triggers, creating five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawns, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-2292-3108.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.
628-2292-3108.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

618-3596.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
618-3596.description:
Cast Echoing Equation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing all creatures you control to become non-legendary copies of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate an untapped non-legendary Kiki-Jiki you control by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 2.

168-736-2210-5290.description:
Cast Mirrormade by paying {2}{U}.
Mirrormade enters the battlefield as a copy of Oblivion Ring, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Mirrormade's trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Copy Enchantment by paying {2}{U}.
Copy Enchantment enters the battlefield as a copy of the Oblivion Ring copy, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Copy Enchantment's trigger, exiling Mirrormade.
Mirrormade leaves the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Sage of Mysteries and Oblivion Ring trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Copy Enchantment.
Copy Enchantment leaves the battlefield, returning Mirrormade from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until each opponent has an empty library, then end the loop by choosing to copy or exile any other permanent.
